name: forge
description: maxime's personal operating framework \u2014 packaged, so nothing has to be installed at user scope and every environment reproduces the same setup.

plugins.name: forge-monitor
plugins.description: Out-of-band session observation: records lifecycle and attention events for the session view, and adds no skill, no tool and no context to the session.

plugins.name: forge-guard
plugins.description: Injects what already exists before a session builds a second one, and refuses to end a turn that changed hooks, settings, manifests or CI without an independent review.
